about_short_description.short_description: Ruuf is a solar marketplace that connects homeowners with solar installers and lenders.

product.name: Residential Solar Panel Installation
product.description: A service providing complete solar panel system installations for residential homes, including equipment, installation, and connection to the electrical grid.

product.name: Online Solar Quotation Tool
product.description: A web-based tool that provides homeowners with customized solar installation proposals based on their home’s characteristics and energy consumption.

product.name: Solar Financing Options
product.description: Financing plans that enable homeowners to install solar systems with no upfront payment and pay over 10 to 25 years through monthly installments.

product.name: Project Management and Administrative Services
product.description: Management of all technical, administrative, and regulatory tasks required for solar system installation and grid connection.

product.name: Installer Partner Platform
product.description: A platform that connects solar installers with customers and manages installation requests and scheduling.
